reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified the post-power-cut clock lockout on the first turn, gave usable clock-setting steps when asked, confirmed the fix once the oven heated, and recommended no part or engineer. Conversation 2 started well but then ignored the customer's repeated direct request for clock-setting instructions, asked irrelevant grill and fan checks, and ended by blaming the fan motor as 'the likely cause' and pointing toward an engineer - a wrong diagnosis and unnecessary escalation for a fault that only needed the time set. Conversation 2 also padded responses with boilerplate heat warnings on a cold, non-functioning oven, wasting the homeowner's time without resolving anything.
